the role of Cdk5 in normal brain development, particularly in neuronal migration and survival.
neuronal Cdk5 activity and its role in normal development and survival.
the molecular mechanisms that regulate neuronal differentiation and survival

Cdk5 kinase activity is necessary for the survival of p35 expressing neurons, and the Cdk5 kinase is not necessary for the survival and development of p35 non-expressing neurons, astrocytes, or glia.
Cdk5 is necessary for neuronal survival and that it plays a critical role in the development of the nervous system.
the Cdk5 activity in neurons is critical for survival.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Cdk5/p35 complex is required for neuronal survival.
neuronal Cdk5 activity, not the expression of the Cdk-5/p35 complex, is required for neuronal survival.
neuronal Cdk5 activity in the nervous system is critical for survival.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neuronal Cdk5 activity plays a critical role in neuronal survival, which is independent of its role in cell cycle regulation.
